# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V2031 not_show"
description: "A value whose type is not Show was interpolated or printed."
---

An error from the `type` phase. `sakura explain V2031` prints this explanation offline.

A value whose type is not `Show` was interpolated or printed. `Secret<T>` is never `Show`, so
secrets cannot leak into strings or logs (design §6.4).

Wrong:

```sakura
Log.event(Level.Info, "token {token}", [])
```

Fixed:

```sakura
Log.event(Level.Info, "token set", [])
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V2031_secret_interpolated.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V2031_secret_interpolated.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
fn leak() -> Unit ! {Env, Log} {
  let token = Env.secret("BILLING_TOKEN").expect("BILLING_TOKEN")
  Log.event(Level.Info, "token {token}", [])
}
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V2031_secret_interpolated.fixed.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V2031_secret_interpolated.fixed.sak), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

```sakura
fn leak() -> Unit ! {Env, Log} {
  let _token = Env.secret("BILLING_TOKEN").expect("BILLING_TOKEN")
  Log.event(Level.Info, "token set", [])
}
```
